roomTypeEditor.slotInfoText:
📦 Slot concepts at a glance

• Each slot is a "request" to the generator.
  It defines: size, category, placement rules.

• Footprint (W × H): how many cells in the room are occupied.
  "Rotatable" allows the generator to swap W and H.

• Required slot: always filled, no matter how big the room is.

• Priority: optional slots are drawn in order of priority
  (0 = first). Random order for equal priority.

• Anchor rules: link this slot relative to another one.
  – Anchor target: slot ID of another slot OR a variant-group ID.
    (Group ID → the generator uses the slot actually chosen from that group.)
  – Positions (OR): multiple positions = the generator picks one of them.
    Example: HeadLeft + HeadRight → nightstand to the left or right of the bed.
  – AND (both sides at once): two separate slots, each with its own rule,
    one with "HeadLeft", one with "HeadRight".
  – Multiple rules: if the anchor is a group ID, each group variant
    can have its own rule with different positions.

• 🔀 Variant group (one-of):
  Multiple slots in one group → the generator picks exactly
  ONE variant and ignores the others.
  Living room example:
    Group "seating" – Variant A: 1× sofa (weight 3)
    Group "seating" – Variant B: sofa + table (weight 2)
  → Probability A = 3/5, B = 2/5

  A variant can also include linked anchor slots
  (anchor slots don't have their own group ID – they
  are automatically pulled in when their main slot is chosen).

slotCard.priorityTitle: Priority: optional slots are drawn in ascending order (0 = first)
slotCard.copyToClipboard: Copy slot to clipboard (can also be pasted into another room configuration)
slotCard.canRotateTitle: Rotatable: slot can also be placed rotated by 90°
slotCard.priorityInputTitleRequired: Priority has no effect on required slots – required slots are always processed.
slotCard.priorityInputTitleOptional: Optional slots are drawn in ascending priority order (0 = first).
slotCard.weightInfoTitle:
Range: 1–10

Determines how often this category is preferred over other allowed categories.

Example: category A with weight 3 and B with weight 1 → A is chosen 75% of the time.

Only affects WHICH tile is placed, not WHETHER the slot is filled.
slotCard.placementRulesInfoTitle:
All active rules are combined with AND – a cell must satisfy ALL set conditions simultaneously.

Exception: 'Room centre' and 'Near wall with orientation' are soft preferences (preferred, but not a hard exclusion).
slotCard.andWarning: AND combination: cell must satisfy {{rules}} simultaneously. If no cell matches → [WARN] in the log.
slotCard.allowOnPathTitle: If enabled: furniture in this slot may also be placed on walking-path cells. By default, furniture with collision is kept off paths.
slotCard.blocksPlacementTitle:
If enabled (default): occupied cells are marked as "occupied" after placement – other slots can no longer use these cells.

If disabled: cells stay free, other slots can use the same cell.
Needed for objects placed on top of other furniture:
• Table lamp on nightstand → blocksPlacement: OFF
• Radio on dresser → blocksPlacement: OFF
• Sink on vanity cabinet → blocksPlacement: OFF
slotCard.softBlockOn: (only requiresSlot slots may be placed on it)
slotCard.softBlockOff: (off – anything may land on this cell)
slotCard.softBlockTitle:
If enabled: cells go into softOccupied.
Normal slots will not land on them.
Slots with requiresSlot (e.g. a lamp via AnchorRules) ignore softOccupied and may be placed there.

Typical use: nightstand
  blocksPlacement: OFF + soft block: ON

Rug: blocksPlacement: OFF + soft block: OFF (anything may go on it)
slotCard.blocksFrontCellTitle:
If enabled: the cell directly in front of the placed tile (in its facing direction) is reserved – other slots cannot place furniture there, but the player can still walk into it.

Typical use: stove, fridge – the cell in front should stay clear.
slotCard.wallAlignmentInfoTitle:
Determines how the furniture is oriented relative to the wall.

• Automatic: the generator picks the best matching tile variant.
• Perpendicular (⊥): back against the wall, front faces into the room.
  For furniture that projects into the room (bed, desk, toilet).
  Prefers a tile variant whose long axis is perpendicular to the wall.
• Parallel (∥): long side along the wall.
  For furniture placed along the wall (sofa, shelf, dresser).
  Prefers a tile variant whose long axis is parallel to the wall.

Note: requires tile variants in the VariantGroup with correct TileLayout dimensions.
slotCard.groupWeightInfoRequired:
Range: 1–10

Weight determines the selection probability within the variant group.

This slot is required (✅) – the generator GUARANTEES that a variant from the group is chosen. The weight only controls WHICH variant is chosen, not whether one is placed.
slotCard.groupWeightInfoOptional:
Range: 1–10

Weight determines the selection probability within the variant group.

This slot is optional (☐) – the generator decides based on priority and room size whether the group is drawn at all. If it is, the weight determines the variant.
slotCard.groupRequiredHint: ✅🔀 Required group "{{group}}" – guarantees exactly one of {{count}} variants will be placed (weight: {{weight}})
slotCard.groupOptionalHint: ☐🔀 Optional group "{{group}}" – one of {{count}} variants may be placed (weight: {{weight}})
slotCard.groupMixedWarning: ⚠ Group "{{group}}" has mixed required/optional slots – all slots in a group should have the same required status.
slotCard.colorGroupTitle:
Color-group ID for this slot.

• Empty = inherits the room default
• "none" = no color filter (e.g. chair, mirror)
• Custom value = own group (e.g. "accent" for a rug)

The first slot in a group determines the color. All following slots in the same group filter their tiles to this color.
slotCard.tileGroupTitle:
Tile-group ID for coherent model selection.

All slots with the same tileGroupId come from the same VariantGroup (tile level).

• Empty = no binding (each slot chooses independently)
• Value = e.g. "dining_chairs" – the first slot fixes the VariantGroup, all subsequent ones filter on it.

Example: 4 chairs at a table → all get the same chair type (chair_beige_01).
slotCard.materialFilterTitle:
Material filter: only tiles whose materials list contains this value are eligible.

• Empty = no material filter (default)
• "none" = no filter for this slot (explicitly disabled)
• Value = only tiles from this material

Combined with AND with the color filter.
slotCard.requiresSlotTitle:
This slot is only attempted if the named slot (ID or group ID) was successfully placed before.

Examples:
• Table lamp → ID of the desk slot
• Sink → ID of the vanity-cabinet slot
• Microwave → ID of the kitchen-counter slot

Unlike AnchorRules: only determines WHETHER the slot is attempted, not where it ends up.
slotCard.requiresSlotPlaceholder: Slot ID or group ID (empty = independent)
slotCard.anchorRulesInfoTitle:
Links this slot relative to another slot or variant group.

• Anchor target: slot ID or group ID
• Positions (OR): the generator picks one of them
• Multiple rules: different positions for different group variants
slotCard.noAnchor: No anchor – free placement in the room
slotCard.orPositions_one: ↕ OR: the generator picks one of the {{count}} allowed positions
slotCard.orPositions_other: ↕ OR: the generator picks one of the {{count}} allowed positions
slotCard.offsetTitle:
Offset along the anchor edge.
0 = first cell, 1 = second, -1 = last cell, etc.
slotCard.distanceTitle: Distance limits for oppositeWall in cells. min=1 starts directly in front of the anchor.
slotCard.distanceMinTitle: Minimum distance to the opposite wall
slotCard.previewUnresolved: No valid offset for wall {{wall}} with this position/orient combo
slotCard.previewMultiPosition: Previewing position 1 of {{count}} (OR – generator picks one at runtime)
slotCard.previewAnchorFallback: Anchor footprint unknown (group anchor or not yet created) – previewing with 1×1 placeholder
slotCard.previewRotationNote: Rotation not simulated – preview assumes base footprint
slotCard.fallbackRulesInfoTitle:
If the primary placement rules cannot find a free cell,
the generator tries these rules in order as an alternative.

• Each fallback rule is a complete set of placement rules.
• Only relevant for required slots – optional slots are simply skipped.
• Example: primary near wall → fallback 1: free placement (no restriction).
slotCard.noFallback: No fallback – if placement fails, the slot is skipped
slotCard.fallbackOnPathTitle: May be placed on path cells (e.g. rugs)

layoutVariants.commonSlotsHint: 💡 Common slots always run in addition to the variant's core slots when a layout variant is active.
layoutVariants.noVariants: No layout variants defined – the generator treats the slots normally.
layoutVariants.disabledTooltip: When unchecked, this variant is excluded from layout selection and fallback attempts. Use this to temporarily disable a variant without deleting it.
layoutVariants.dropZoneHint: 📌 Drag slot IDs here or use the list below
layoutVariants.variantHint: 💡 Variant = core slots for the shape. Common slots are added on top from the global common list.

pools.noPoolsHint: No pool segments. Add one to randomise furniture within a wall chain.
pools.countBySizeTooltip: Min/max range of wall positions this pool generates per room size. The generator tries the maximum count first; if the full-fit solver fails, it retries with one fewer slot, down to the minimum. Example: min=2, max=3 → tries 3 first, falls back to 2 if the room is too tight. Set both to 0 to disable the pool for that size.
